data.value: {0,1}The machining of the threads diameters is affected by a tolerance field\par {0,1} which lies entirely on the plus side for the holes and on the minus side\par

data.name: stop054
data.value: {0,1}for the shafts. The width of the tolerance field taken in account in the\par {0,1} present calculations is {{\b {1:0.0000} mm}}.\par\par

data.name: stop055
data.value: {0,1}The blow-up of the diameter of the channel threaded end because of the \par {0,1} pressure and mechanical loads produces a partial disengagement of the \par

data.name: stop056
data.value: {0,1}threaded coupling which is taken in account in the present calculations.\par {0,1} The calculated increase on the channel end radius has been {{\b {1:0.0000} mm}}\par in design conditions, and {{\b {2:##.###} mm}} in leak condition.\par \par

data.name: stop057
data.value: {0,1}A transient metal temperature field, producing a further partial disengagement\par {0,1} of the threaded coupling has been considered. The temperature of the lock\par

data.name: stop058
data.value: {0,1}ring was {1:####.##}\'b0C, the temperature of the channel end was {{\b {2:##.### \'b0C}}, and\par {0,1} the resulting disengagement on the radius has been {{\b {3:##.### mm}}.\par\par

data.name: stop059
data.value: {0,1}The combination of all the effects described above gives, as a result, a \par {0,1} residual height of the engaged portion of the threads by {{\b {1:0.0000} mm}}\par in design conditions, and {{\b {2:0.0000} mm}} in leak condition.\par \par

data.name: str09008
data.value: Se si sceglie l'opzione monolaterale la pressione differenziale agirà in con- dizioni di progetto solo dal lato tubi. Essa sarà quindi dimensionante per la piastra tubiera, ma non per il sistema di compressione della guarnizione sotto di essa. La pressione differenziale di prova idraulica lato mantello viene specificata nella scheda 'Piastra tubiera'. Se si sceglie l'opzione bilaterale, la pressione differenziale di progetto agi- rà su entrambi i lati, e la pressione differenziale di prova idraulica potrà essere determinata a partoire da essa secondo le regole di UG-99.
